content_voiceover: This is the full diagnostic algorithm for VWD from the 2021 James et al Blood Advances guideline, tying together everything from the last few slides. Start with a suspected VWD patient and apply a bleeding assessment tool; a negative score rules out VWD, a positive score triggers CBC, PT, PTT, then VWF antigen, platelet-dependent VWF activity, and factor eight activity. VWF levels above fifty rule out VWD. Levels thirty to fifty are ambiguous, proceed only if there's a bleeding history. Levels below thirty, or thirty to fifty with bleeding, move to the platelet-dependent activity to antigen ratio. A ratio above zero point seven means type 1, confirmed with a DDAVP trial, normalized levels define type 1C. A ratio below zero point seven means type 2, further split by collagen binding or multimer analysis, abnormal points to type 2A or 2B, confirmed genetically, normal points to type 2M. Separately, factor eight disproportionately lower than VWF triggers factor eight binding or genetic testing to confirm type 2N. This figure is the testable roadmap linking bleeding score, screening, and confirmatory testing into one pathway.
keypoints: BAT positive -> CBC, PT/PTT -> VWF:Ag, activity, FVIII:C
VWF >50: r/o VWD; 30-50 + bleeding, or <30 -> activity/Ag ratio
FVIII << VWF -> check VWF:FVIIIB/genetics -> confirm type 2N
